dateCreated.description: When the service hook was created (ISO 8601).

events.description: The events the service hook is subscribed to, such as `event.alert` and `event.created`.

id.description: The ID of the service hook.

secret.description: The secret used to sign the requests that Sentry sends to the hook URL.

status.description: The status of the service hook, such as `active` or `disabled`.

url.description: The URL that receives the service hook requests.
